kind: isolated Miniflare Stranger browser runs with fixture GitHub, Spark and runner; no real credentials or jobs

steps.name: front door: preview password
welcome tour shows, then skip
play first: the demo shop, no sign-in
sign in with GitHub (real, not the sandbox)
no repos yet: install the App
back in Shiptorio, repo is listed by itself
open the factory
real factory work reaches the agent handoff
the agent handoff reaches Power, not a dead end
signed issue arrives once, even on delivery retry
pair a fixture runner through device approval
Spark proposes a plan; no build before approval
runner publishes a PR with receipts on the approved head
stale green CI cannot advance the current PR
current-head CI, verify bay and Spark review pass
Launch card merges only after the player holds the red button
no silent provider fallback or browser errors
